summary: Rezolve AI plc furnished a Form 6-K with the SEC on October 7, 2026, disclosing materials from an investor day held October 6, 2026. Management presented business developments and strategic plans, including full-year 2026 revenue guidance of approximately $360 million, a targeted ARR exit rate of at least $500 million, and roughly $60 million of annualized efficiency savings. No transaction, price, stake, premium, advisor, or board recommendation was disclosed. This is a routine investor-relations disclosure rather than a special situation; watch integration progress, cash burn, and financing risk.
